climate_pressure: Climate-related seasonal water-supply pressure and rising irrigation demand.
documented_impact: Scarcity in the irrigation-dependent Dashoguz production system.
fcv_mediator: Water-intensive crops, inefficient irrigation and competing demands concentrate pressure on limited water.
possible_consequence: The 2024 risk assessment warns of possible conflict among water users; it does not report violence or dispute incidence.
alternative_explanations: Upstream withdrawals, crop choice, infrastructure losses and allocation decisions affect scarcity independently of climate.
uncertainty: A stakeholder-informed conditional mechanism, not an identified causal effect, current dispute count or armed-conflict forecast. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: The assessment proposes water-saving practices and coordination; the independent evaluation identifies some water-saving uptake but limited scaling.
compact_statement: Climate-related water pressure and inefficient, competing irrigation uses can create water-user disputes in Dashoguz; violence is not established.
